purpose: Prevent silently idle gaps between arbitrary8M-action batches while preserving verification and human stop controls.
learner: One unchanged32-env PPO/SIL/reference-KL learner,16protected,50k/stride2; --steps0 removes the tranche cutoff, with additional_steps left at its non-inherited zero default. No automated hyperparameter search.
supervision: Local Python process,15second heartbeat, owned-child liveness and code/space checks; no Codex/LLM/API calls or usage-limit override.
validation: Each new complete20-game primary depth/count record is audited on50 reused secondary seeds. Promote only higher complete70-game rank plus exact uncapped replay and all neural actions verified. Learner may continue while its frozen checkpoint is audited.
final_gate: Only after verified promoted Level10:stop learner, freeze exact weights, run100 uncapped fresh games40000–40099 once. No model selection using fresh games.
stop_rules: 15minutes without learner log events (fault watchdog only)
limitations: Does not guarantee Level10 or invent new experiments; records needs_attention when review is necessary. Does not restart after a machine reboot or restore the app's usage-limited goal. Operator can resume goal via product controls.
